leadText:
YUU (Japanese: YUU, lit. Superb) is the Japanese theme song for Episode: Mega Evolution and the fifth ending song of . It debuted as an ending song in HZ112, replacing Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on the CD and as a digital single on August 27, 2025.
plainText:
YUU (Japanese: YUU, lit. Superb) is the Japanese theme song for Episode: Mega Evolution and the fifth ending song of . It debuted as an ending song in HZ112, replacing Ready Go.

The full version of the song was released on the CD and as a digital single on August 27, 2025.

==Ending animation: Version 1 (HZ112)==
 
===Synopsis===
The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order):
A zoomed-in shot of Roy's Mega Ring, slowly zooming out
Roy, , and Captain Pikachu standing on a cliff side beside the Brave Olivine, looking at the cloudy horizon
Roy, Cap, Crocalor, and on their journey
Master Mayonnaise telling some kids about a Heracronite
Emma and Mimi putting up a missing poster for a on a signboard
Yellow Flash standing on the Lost Mayo Maze roof, looking into the distance
Roy, Crocalor, Ult, and , facing someone in a battle in the Lost Mayo Maze
Roy and Ult having a training battle
Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon
Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face
The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Roy and his Pokémon with a determined expression.

==Ending animation: Version 2 (HZ113)==
 
===Synopsis===
The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order):
A zoomed-in shot of Ult's Mega Ring, slowly zooming out
Ult and sitting on a couch in the open while it rains
Ult walking on a busy street during this volunteer city cleaner gig
Master Mayonnaise telling some kids about a Heracronite
Emma and Mimi putting up a missing poster for a on a signboard
Yellow Flash standing on the Lost Mayo Maze roof, looking into the distance
Roy, Crocalor, Ult, and facing someone in a battle in the Lost Mayo Maze
Roy and Ult having a training battle
Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon
Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face
The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Ult and his Sableye with an arrogant expression.

==Ending animation: Version 3 (HZ114)==
 
===Synopsis===
The ending animation consists of the scene panning over the following still images (in order):
A zoomed-in shot of Roy's Mega Ring, slowly zooming out
Emma and Mimi welcoming back the partially offscreen Ult and Roy with a wave
Ult packing his bag while Roy is asleep, being helped by 
Master Mayonnaise telling some kids about a Heracronite
Emma and Mimi putting up a missing poster for a on a signboard
Count Hoisin, , Shōyu, and in the yard of the Lost Mayo Maze, with Master Mayonnaise in his civilian attire in the background
Roy, , Cap, and seemingly lost in Lumiose City alleys
Roy and Ult having a training battle
Emma serving food to Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon
Roy, Ult, and their Pokémon sleeping, with Ult having moved around so much in his sleep that his leg is poking Roy's face
The last shot is a continuation of the first one, zooming out fully to show Roy and his Pokémon with a determined expression. This shot is similar to the last from from the first version, updated to show Roy with his new jacket and without his hat, and now including his newly caught Lucario.

==Lyrics==
===TV size===
 
! Japanese
! Rōmaji
! English

野暮な輩がにごす　横目にひたすら進む

なぜに生まれし命　運命は我が身を試すよ
宵の明星ひとり　 った 光を待つ

ならば炎の中　潜む
悲しみも憎しみも　吹けよ　金色の風

U…You & I　愛こそだって？　言い訳にすんな
U…夢じゃない　あんたは誰　邪魔しなさんな
幕を上げるのは　俺らに託されてる 

Yabona yakara ga nigosu yokome ni hitasura susumu

Naze ni umareshi inochi sadame wa wagami o tamesu yo
Yoi no myōjō hitori tsumutta manako hikari o matsu

Naraba honō no naka hisomu
Kanashimi mo nikushimi mo fukeyo konjiki no kaze

U…You & I Ai koso datte? Iiwake ni sunna
U…Yume janai anta wa dare jama shinasanna
Maku o ageru no wa orera ni takusareteru 

The boorish bunch beats around the bush, glancing sideways as I press onwards

Why have I been brought into this world? Fate tests my very being
The evening star glimmers in solitude as closed eyes await the light

Then, go lurk beneath the flames
Let the golden wind blow away the sorrow and the hatred

U... You & I, is love all there is to it? Don't make excuses
U... It's not a dream. Who do you think you are? Don't get in my way
The curtain rises, leaving it all to us
